title: Open direct-image comparison factors through right-derived units
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $V\subset Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$, and $f_0:U\to V$. Let $F,F_0,r_X,r_Y$ be module direct image and exact restriction, and let $e_h:F_h\mathbin{\star}r_{Yh}\cong r_{Xh}\mathbin{\star}F_{0h}$ be [def-pc-e2-open-homotopy-direct-image-iso]. Let $Q_h$ localize the homotopy category to the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\beta_F,\beta_{F_0}$ be the recorded right-derived units [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], and $\rho_X:Q_hr_{Xh}\cong R_XQ_h$, $\rho_Y:Q_hr_{Yh}\cong R_YQ_h$ the inverses of the exact-restriction factorization isomorphisms [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For every homotopy-category object $I$, the explicitly constructed derived comparison $b$ [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons] satisfies $\rho_Y(F_h I)\gg R_Y(\beta_F(I))\gg b(Q_hI)=Q_h(e_h(I))\gg\beta_{F_0}(r_{Xh}I)\gg Rf_{0*}(\rho_X(I))$. There is no K-injectivity or boundedness assumption.

proof.text: Expand the four factors of the derived open direct-image comparison. Apply the unit factorization of right-derived uniqueness to the exact-postcomposition and K-injective-preserving composition factors, and the unit factorization of the right-derived natural isomorphism to the sectionwise comparison. Replace the unit of derived exact restriction with its termwise factorization using rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac. Reassociate and use naturality to obtain the asserted equation. These universal-property equations hold for every homotopy-category I.
